data.displayName: Origin Weekday Shift - New & Move Customers Only

fees.description: A $92.55 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A $43.23 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A fee of $15.00 (GST exempt) may apply if your bill is not paid by the due date.
A 0.27% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by VISA debit card.
A 0.65% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by VISA credit card.
A 0.33% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by Mastercard debit card.
A 0.67% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by Mastercard credit card.
If you pay at an Australia Post outlet, a payment processing fee of the higher of $2.70 or 0.49% (incl GST) may apply.
A 0.64% fee (GST Incl) may apply to payments made by American Express credit card.
A $88.00 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected for non payment. Fee may vary.

electricityContract.terms: Off peak electricity rates apply from 9am to 5pm weekdays, all other times are considered peak. This offer is best suited if you can shift your usage to the off-peak usage period, if you cannot, your electricity costs could be higher. Offer not available in all areas. Residential customers only. Visit originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions for more.
electricityContract.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. The notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date of the variation.

incentives.description: One credit per electricity account. If this Origin Weekday Shift electricity plan is still active with the customer on 13 September 2026, $200 (Incl. GST) credit will be applied to the customer's electricity account after that date. If the customer ends this Origin Weekday Shift electricity plan before that date, the customer will not receive any credit. Credit is not redeemable for cash.

eligibility.description: A smart/digital meter is required to access this Energy Plan. Origin can help arrange a meter upgrade if you don't have one already.
Offer only available to new residential electricity customers, and existing customers moving to a new property
Credit will only be applied if you haven't received a credit in the previous 12 months

timeOfUseRates.description: All other times (12am - 9am, 5pm - 12am Monday to Friday | All time Weekends)

solarFeedInTariff.description: Origin offers 3 cents per kWh exported, subject to eligibility. All amounts are GST-inclusive (if any).

electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: You must pay us any charges your distributor imposes on us in relation to services performed by your distributor (or anyone else) at your supply address. For details on additional charges that may apply see www.originenergy.com.au/2402/Additional-charges
